kit.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer Intern position at Weekday. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team.

During my professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL that went live for real customer bookings. Additionally, I delivered a POS system for a restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server deployed on Azure.

In my academic and personal projects, such as Zenvest and StaySphere, I have built full-stack applications leveraging modern JavaScript technologies, REST APIs, and database management with MongoDB and MySQL. These projects allowed me to implement secure authentication, server-side request validation, and multi-service deployment.

I am excited about the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real projects, and further grow my technical skills in a fast-paced environment.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your needs.

Sincerely,
Amaanuddin Ahmed
